","id":"27b94a9c-7bb1-40c9-afdd-febf6ce07ba4","lists":[{"text":"About the Role","content":"

Pocket FM is seeking an Audio Engineer to join our Japan team and ensure the highest quality audio experience across our Japanese catalog. This role is responsible for reviewing AI-generated audio, identifying quality issues, documenting corrections, and producing polished final episodes through audio patching, editing, and quality control.

As the Audio Engineer, you'll work closely with Voice-Over Artists, production partners, and cross-functional teams to maintain exceptional technical and creative audio standards. You'll be responsible for identifying audio errors, coordinating revisions, and seamlessly stitching corrected dialogue, pickups, and re-recorded segments into finished episodes.

This is an ideal opportunity for an audio engineering or post-production professional with a strong ear for voice performance, technical audio quality, and spoken-word production workflows who enjoys combining hands-on technical execution with creative judgment.

"},{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"
  • Perform quality control on AI-generated audio by reviewing completed episodes for pronunciation, pacing, emotional delivery, technical issues, and overall listening experience.
  • Identify audio errors and document clear, actionable correction notes for Voice-Over Artists and production partners.
  • Edit and patch audio by seamlessly stitching corrected dialogue, pickups, and re-recorded segments into finished episodes using professional audio editing and patching software.
  • Ensure patched audio maintains consistent tone, pacing, ambience, volume, and technical quality throughout each episode.
  • Troubleshoot audio issues related to cuts, mispronunciations, abrupt transitions, background noise, pacing, performance quality, and technical inconsistencies.
  • Coordinate recording revisions and pickups with Voice-Over Artists and production partners to resolve quality issues efficiently.
  • Maintain audio quality standards, QC processes, and documentation to ensure consistency across all productions.
  • Collaborate with Content, Localization, Product, and Production teams to resolve production issues and continuously improve workflows.
  • Track recurring quality issues and recommend process improvements to enhance production efficiency and listener experience.
"},{"text":"Qualifications","content":"
  • Hands-on experience in audio engineering, audio post-production, sound editing, dubbing, spoken-word production, or audio quality assurance within media, entertainment, gaming, or related industries.
  • Experience reviewing spoken audio for pronunciation, performance quality, pacing, clarity, and technical accuracy.
  • Proficiency using professional audio editing software and audio patching workflows to integrate pickups, corrections, and re-recorded dialogue into finished productions.
  • Strong technical understanding of audio editing, patching, sound consistency, transitions, levels, ambience, and quality control.
  • Experience coordinating with Voice-Over Artists, recording teams, studios, or production partners to resolve audio quality issues.
  • Strong understanding of audio production workflows, recording processes, and quality assurance best practices.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to identify subtle performance, linguistic, and technical issues.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple productions simultaneously.
  • Native or near-native Japanese language proficiency with excellent listening skills and cultural awareness.
  • Experience in audio entertainment, gaming, animation, dubbing, podcasts, streaming, localization, or creator platforms is highly preferred.
  • Passion for storytelling and creating exceptional audio experiences for listeners.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Video Quality Reviewer – Sketch Content  with a sharp creative eye to join our team.

In this entry-level role, you will be the guardian of our visual quality. You will review sketch-based video assets to ensure that every scene, character, and visual element perfectly matches the audio, script, and storytelling mood before it moves to final production.

No prior formal experience is required! If you love digital storytelling, have great attention to detail, and can spot small visual inconsistencies that others miss, we will provide the training and guidelines you need to succeed.

What You’ll Do

  • Review Visuals & Audio: Watch and review sketch-based video episodes, ensuring the visuals match the script, voiceover/audio, and scene descriptions.
  • Spot Inconsistencies: Catch small details like continuity errors, character design mismatches, missing elements, or pacing issues between the audio and images.
  • Log Feedback Clearly: Take simple notes and log issues (referencing specific timestamps or frames) so our artists and editors know exactly what to adjust.
  • Maintain Trackers: Keep our daily QC status trackers and checklists updated with review statuses and approvals.
  • Collaborate: Work closely with our production team to ensure high-quality content is delivered on time.

What We Are Looking For

  • Sharp Attention to Detail: You naturally notice small visual errors, continuity breaks, or misalignments between what you see and what you hear.
  • A Keen Creative Eye: A genuine interest in visual storytelling, animation, comics, digital video, or content creation.
  • Clear Written Communication: Ability to describe visual errors simply, objectively, and politely.
  • Organized & Focused: Comfortable reviewing multiple video segments and keeping spreadsheets or trackers organized.
  • Open to Learning: You take feedback well and are eager to learn production workflows.
  • Experience: None required! Fresh graduates, career transitioners, and enthusiastic self-starters are welcome to apply.

Nice to Have (Not Mandatory)

  • Basic familiarity with Google Sheets or Excel.
  • Basic understanding of video editing or digital illustration concepts.
  • Fluency / working proficiency in English.

Why Join Us?

  • A great entry point into the creative and digital production industry.
  • Hands-on training on quality control, storytelling workflows, and pre-production processes.
  • A collaborative, supportive remote work environment.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Video Quality Reviewer – Sketch Content  with a sharp creative eye to join our team.

In this entry-level role, you will be the guardian of our visual quality. You will review sketch-based video assets to ensure that every scene, character, and visual element perfectly matches the audio, script, and storytelling mood before it moves to final production.

No prior formal experience is required! If you love digital storytelling, have great attention to detail, and can spot small visual inconsistencies that others miss, we will provide the training and guidelines you need to succeed.

What You’ll Do

  • Review Visuals & Audio: Watch and review sketch-based video episodes, ensuring the visuals match the script, voiceover/audio, and scene descriptions.
  • Spot Inconsistencies: Catch small details like continuity errors, character design mismatches, missing elements, or pacing issues between the audio and images.
  • Log Feedback Clearly: Take simple notes and log issues (referencing specific timestamps or frames) so our artists and editors know exactly what to adjust.
  • Maintain Trackers: Keep our daily QC status trackers and checklists updated with review statuses and approvals.
  • Collaborate: Work closely with our production team to ensure high-quality content is delivered on time.

What We Are Looking For

  • Sharp Attention to Detail: You naturally notice small visual errors, continuity breaks, or misalignments between what you see and what you hear.
  • A Keen Creative Eye: A genuine interest in visual storytelling, animation, comics, digital video, or content creation.
  • Clear Written Communication: Ability to describe visual errors simply, objectively, and politely.
  • Organized & Focused: Comfortable reviewing multiple video segments and keeping spreadsheets or trackers organized.
  • Open to Learning: You take feedback well and are eager to learn production workflows.
  • Experience: None required! Fresh graduates, career transitioners, and enthusiastic self-starters are welcome to apply.

Nice to Have (Not Mandatory)

  • Basic familiarity with Google Sheets or Excel.
  • Basic understanding of video editing or digital illustration concepts.
  • Fluency / working proficiency in English.

Why Join Us?

  • A great entry point into the creative and digital production industry.
  • Hands-on training on quality control, storytelling workflows, and pre-production processes.
  • A collaborative, supportive remote work environment.

","id":"75f88e94-dcd7-4660-b16b-3dd91909d64f","lists":[{"text":"About the Role","content":"

Pocket FM is seeking a Japanese Localization Writer / QC to help bring our long-form audio and video drama content to Japanese audiences.

In this role, you'll review AI-generated Japanese translations and dubbing scripts against the original English content, identifying and correcting issues in meaning, naturalness, character voice, emotional delivery, and story continuity. You'll ensure Japanese dialogue sounds native and authentic while preserving the intent, relationships, emotion, and pacing of the original story.

This is a highly hands-on writing and quality-control role for someone with a strong command of Japanese and a deep understanding of dialogue, storytelling, and cultural nuance.

"},{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

  • Review AI-generated Japanese scripts against English source content to identify translation and localization issues.

  • Rewrite dialogue and narration into natural, emotionally appropriate spoken Japanese.

  • Verify speaker and character attribution, names, titles, honorifics, and terminology for accuracy and consistency.

  • Evaluate character voice, relationship dynamics, hierarchy, and language register, including casual, formal, intimate, respectful, and confrontational dialogue.

  • Ensure localized scripts preserve story meaning, character relationships, emotional intent, and important plot details.

  • Review pacing and timing to ensure dialogue is natural to speak and fits the available scene without compromising story content.

  • Identify and correct issues with emotional or delivery direction and provide clear feedback where needed.

  • Maintain consistency across characters, recurring terms, storylines, and episodes.

  • Identify recurring patterns or weaknesses in AI-generated Japanese and provide recommendations to improve future localization passes.

  • Consistently deliver high-quality work within established review timelines.

"},{"text":"Qualifications","content":"

  • Native or near-native Japanese writing ability with excellent command of natural spoken Japanese.

  • Strong professional English proficiency, with the ability to understand English source material and collaborate with global teams.

  • Experience writing, editing, adapting, or localizing scripts or other long-form narrative content.

  • Strong understanding of dialogue, character voice, emotional nuance, pacing, and serialized storytelling.

  • Ability to distinguish between literal translation and natural, culturally appropriate Japanese adaptation.

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify subtle issues in meaning, tone, character relationships, and continuity.

  • Comfortable reviewing and improving AI-generated content.

  • Experience with TV, film, anime, audio drama, web fiction, gaming, dubbing, subtitles, or other entertainment localization is highly preferred.

  • Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

  • Passion for storytelling and bringing international content to Japanese audiences.

","id":"3098c4e6-ac62-4d80-8dd9-fd6dd551d8db","lists":[{"text":"About the Role","content":"

Pocket FM is seeking a Creative Director to join our Japan Marketing team in a fully remote role based in Japan. This position requires professional fluency in both Japanese and English, as you will create marketing content for Japanese audiences while partnering closely with global teams across Marketing, Creative, Production, Product, and Performance Marketing.

This is a storytelling-first creative leadership role. Unlike traditional marketing roles focused on short-form advertising, Pocket FM's marketing assets are 30–50 minutes long, requiring the same narrative craft found in television, film, anime, audio drama, and serialized fiction. We're looking for someone with a professional screenwriting background who understands how to sustain audience engagement through strong hooks, character development, emotional escalation, pacing, dialogue, and cliffhangers.

As the Creative Director, you'll lead the creative vision, writing, localization, and optimization of promotional campaigns for the Japanese market. You'll manage writers, editors, and creative collaborators while remaining deeply hands-on in developing scripts, story structures, messaging, and creative direction that keep audiences engaged from beginning to end and inspire them to discover the full series.

This is an ideal opportunity for a creative leader with experience in television, film, anime, audio fiction, gaming, publishing, advertising, or digital media who loves storytelling and wants to shape how millions of people discover their next favorite story.

"},{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

  • Lead the creative vision and storytelling strategy for user acquisition campaigns across the Japanese market.

  • Write, shape, and direct long-form promotional content ranging from 30–50 minutes, applying screenwriting principles including character development, pacing, emotional escalation, dialogue, and cliffhangers.

  • Develop compelling concepts, scripts, messaging, and creative frameworks that capture attention and drive audience engagement.

  • Build testing roadmaps exploring new hooks, openings, characters, story structures, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and creative concepts to continuously improve campaign performance.

  • Adapt and localize successful global campaigns while ensuring they feel culturally authentic and emotionally resonant for Japanese audiences.

  • Oversee the end-to-end creative localization process, including copy adaptation, dubbing, editing, creative review, and final asset delivery.

  • Establish and maintain exceptional creative standards across storytelling, writing quality, pacing, visual execution, and technical production.

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of promo writers, video editors, and creative collaborators to consistently deliver outstanding work.

  • Partner closely with Performance Marketing to evaluate campaign performance and rapidly iterate creative concepts based on audience insights.

  • Analyze campaign performance metrics, including customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, engagement, retention, watch time, and audience drop-off, to identify opportunities for creative optimization.

  • Translate performance insights into stronger storytelling, messaging, and creative execution that scales across campaigns.

  • Support hiring, coaching, and development of creative talent while fostering a culture of experimentation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Production, Product, Localization, and Global Creative teams to deliver campaigns that support business growth.

"},{"text":"Qualifications","content":"

  • Professional screenwriting experience for television, film, anime, audio fiction, serialized fiction, or other long-form narrative entertainment is required.

  • Professional fluency in both Japanese and English, with the ability to collaborate across international teams while creating native-quality creative for Japanese audiences.

  • Exceptional storytelling, writing, and conceptual thinking skills with the ability to develop emotionally engaging, performance-driven creative.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop compelling long-form narratives with strong openings, character-driven storytelling, emotional progression, conflict escalation, and satisfying narrative payoffs.

  • Experience as a Creative Director, Associate Creative Director, Senior Copywriter, Screenwriter, Advertising Creative, Content Creative, or similar creative leadership role.

  • Experience leading writers, editors, creative studios, or multidisciplinary creative teams.

  • Strong understanding of digital advertising, creative testing, and user acquisition marketing.

  • Experience writing or directing promotional content across video, social media, digital advertising, television, film, gaming, publishing, or entertainment.

  • Ability to combine creative intuition with data-driven decision making to continuously improve campaign performance.

  • Experience localizing creative content for Japanese audiences with strong cultural awareness and language quality.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and project management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple creative projects, stakeholders, and production timelines simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in entertainment, gaming, streaming, publishing, audio, web fiction, advertising, or creator platforms is highly preferred.

  • Passion for storytelling, creative experimentation, and building marketing campaigns that inspire audiences to discover new stories.

Pocket FM is looking for Proof Listeners to help ensure the quality and consistency of our Japanese audio content before it reaches listeners. This is a hands-on quality assurance role focused on listening to completed audio episodes, identifying audio, narration, pronunciation, and other production-related issues, and accurately documenting them for the relevant teams.

As a Proof Listener, you will listen carefully to full-length audio episodes, identify any errors or inconsistencies, and log each issue in Pocket FM's CMS with an accurate timestamp and clear description. You will be trained on Pocket FM's quality standards, review process, and CMS workflow to ensure issues are identified and reported consistently and accurately.

The ideal candidate has professional experience in fictional audio entertainment, such as audio dramas, audiobooks, podcasts, or voice-over production, and has a strong understanding of Japanese-language audio and narration quality. Experience in proofreading, proof-listening, editorial review, or audio quality assurance is also highly relevant.

"},{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

  • Listen to full audio episodes carefully and systematically to identify errors, inconsistencies, and quality issues.

  • Review audio for issues including, but not limited to, abrupt audio changes or jerks, glitches, distortion, incorrect or inconsistent pronunciation, narration issues, missing or repeated audio, unnatural pauses, and other production or listening-quality concerns.

  • Evaluate Japanese-language narration and dialogue for pronunciation, wording, delivery, and other issues that may impact the listener experience.

  • Identify the precise timestamp at which each issue occurs.

  • Accurately document each identified issue, including the timestamp, type of issue, and a clear description of the problem.

  • Log all identified errors into Pocket FM's CMS portal using the prescribed review and documentation process.

  • Follow Pocket FM's audio quality guidelines and review standards consistently across episodes.

  • Distinguish genuine audio or content-quality issues from acceptable variations based on the quality standards provided during training.

  • Ensure reported errors are specific, actionable, and sufficiently detailed for the relevant production teams to investigate and resolve.

  • Maintain a high level of attention to detail and consistency when reviewing long-form fictional audio content.

  • Complete assigned audio reviews within expected timelines and communicate any issues that may affect delivery.

  • Incorporate feedback from the quality team and continuously improve accuracy and consistency in identifying and categorizing errors.

  • Maintain confidentiality of unreleased Pocket FM content and any information accessed as part of the freelance engagement.

"},{"text":"Qualifications","content":"

  • Professional experience in fictional audio entertainment is required, such as audio dramas, audiobooks, podcasts, voice-over production, or other narrative-driven audio content.

  • Native-level or highly proficient Japanese language skills are required, with a strong understanding of Japanese pronunciation, dialogue, and natural spoken language.

  • Professional experience in audio production, audio editing, sound production, voice production, or a related field is highly preferred.

  • Experience with proofreading, proof-listening, editorial review, content quality assurance, or similar detail-oriented creative work is highly preferred.

  • Strong ability to listen attentively to long-form audio and identify subtle inconsistencies or quality issues.

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify and document issues accurately.

  • Ability to identify the precise timestamp of an issue and clearly describe what is wrong.

  • Strong written communication skills, particularly the ability to write concise and actionable issue descriptions in Japanese.

  • English-language proficiency is a strong plus, particularly for communicating with cross-functional teams and documenting or discussing issues with non-Japanese-speaking team members.

  • Comfortable working with digital tools and web-based content management systems; experience with CMS platforms is a plus.

  • Ability to follow established quality standards, review guidelines, and workflows consistently.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple episodes and review assignments independently.

  • Reliable internet connection and access to a computer suitable for extended audio review work.

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to join our content team on a contractor basis. In this role, you will create Spanish-language episode videos for our app by adapting approved English-language source videos to Spanish episode audio. You will work with English motion videos or image sheets, Spanish audio, subtitles, and Client-provided AI tools to deliver polished motion and stills episodes that accurately support the Spanish story.

1. Motion Episode Production

  • Create Spanish SRT subtitle files from the episode audio using the AI tool provided by Pocket FM.

  • Combine English episode motion videos with the corresponding Spanish episode audio and ensure accurate synchronization between audio and visuals.

  • Review the Spanish narrative and rearrange English source visuals where needed so that the final motion video supports the Spanish story.

  • Add Spanish subtitles to the completed motion video and submit the episode for quality control review.

    • 2. Stills Episode Production

  • Generate Spanish SRT subtitle files from the applicable Spanish episode audio.

  • Use the English episode image sheet, Spanish episode audio, and SRT file in the Client-designated AI tool to generate the final stills video.

  • Review each stills video for complete, readable subtitles and alignment with the supplied Spanish audio before submission.

    • 3. Quality Control and Rework

  • Submit completed motion and stills episodes for quality control review in accordance with the Client's workflow.

  • Review QC feedback, make the requested corrections, and resubmit episodes until final approval is received.

  • Treat an episode as final only after it has been approved by the Client's quality control reviewers.

    • 4. Collaboration and Production Standards

  • Work closely with the content team and designated stakeholders to clarify source materials, story alignment, quality feedback, and delivery requirements.

  • Follow established content standards and production guidelines to maintain consistency across Spanish episode videos.

  • Manage assigned episodes responsibly and communicate progress, delivery status, and blockers to the reporting manager.

  • Deliver polished, high-quality videos within agreed production timelines.

    • 5. Technology and Continuous Learning

  • Use the Client-provided AI tools for subtitle generation and stills-video production as directed.

  • Stay current with relevant video-editing, subtitling, and AI-assisted production workflows.

  • Adopt new tools, templates, and production processes introduced by the Client.
